dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: No new safeguards decision, qualifying enrichment-production threshold, weaponization order, detonation or NPT withdrawal appeared. IAEA public pages returned HTTP 403 and the browser remained on a verification challenge; reachable UN and targeted Google/Bing lanes added no threshold event. Raw 49; coupled 56

dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN WAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters reports Oman’s Gulf-backed voluntary-fee proposal for Hormuz remains unsigned, while Saudi Arabia said it intercepted another wave of drones launched from Iraq at Eastern Region oil facilities and again blamed Iran-backed militias. The direct U.S.-Iran strike pause still held at cutoff, but the repeated Gulf attacks and Iran’s new warning that ships benefiting from frozen-asset compensation could be denied passage show the channel remains fragile. Raw 100; coupled 100

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
dashboard_trackers.notes: The conditional U.S.-backed pilot redeployment channel remains scheduled for 4–6 August implementation talks and tied to Hezbollah disarmament and Lebanese state control. The rolling-day update found no post-18Z independently verified strike, casualty, Hezbollah movement or framework collapse. Raw 87; coupled 97

dashboard_trackers.name: TURKEY-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: Google, Bing and NATO’s official latest-news page produced no verified Turkish combat entry, unusual force concentration, qualifying long-range weapons event or official strategic-weapons threshold. Raw 5; coupled 5

dashboard_trackers.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: No later attribution or exchange of fire followed the reported suspected drone movement near Samba and Rajouri. The refreshed rolling-day review found no interstate strike, unusual force concentration or fresh Line of Control exchange. Raw 15; coupled 15

dashboard_trackers.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: No Pakistani acknowledgement, retaliation, crossing closure or fresh interstate clash followed the unconfirmed Chitral air-attack claim. UNAMA’s 499-death aggregate remains retrospective through 30 June. Raw 46; coupled 46

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: Ukraine’s foreign minister held a direct call with his Iranian counterpart after the Caspian strike on the vessel Anna. The contact did not produce an announced settlement or Russian response; no new Russian retaliation, NATO combat entry or qualifying strategic step appeared after 18Z. Raw 99; coupled 99

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: Romania’s three Russian-origin drone shootdowns remain the latest direct NATO spillover evidence. NATO’s official page still showed 24 July as its newest news item and no Article 4 consultation, collective-force decision or new alliance response. Raw 58; coupled 68

dashboard_trackers.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Taiwan’s current Han Kuang work is defensive rehearsal for sustaining supply under a simulated blockade. No new Chinese blockade, expanded live-fire operation, amphibious concentration or direct China-Taiwan clash appeared. Raw 24; coupled 28

dashboard_trackers.name: DPRK
dashboard_trackers.notes: The refreshed rolling-day review produced doctrine commentary and older Russia-DPRK reporting, but no current operational deployment order, launcher movement, firing or detonation. Raw 18; coupled 18

dashboard_trackers.name: SUDAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Sudan Tribune newly relayed a rights-group claim of dozens killed in North Kordofan air attacks while army gains around the Omdurman–El Obeid route continued. The casualty report remains one underlying rights-group chain and does not establish a new strategic capture beyond already-scored battlefield movement, so the near-ceiling lane holds. Raw 94; coupled 94

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL PALESTINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: The UN Security Council update records 1,180 Palestinians killed in Gaza since the October 2025 pause, including 59 from 15–22 July, and 18 killed in West Bank settler attacks through 20 July. Those figures are retrospective; no execution, named camp or displacement count followed Katz’s refugee-camp takeover order by cutoff. Raw 94; coupled 94

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH SUDAN ABYEI
dashboard_trackers.notes: The refreshed UN, Google and Bing review produced no new South Sudan-Abyei clash, verified large force movement, transition breakdown or UNISFA posture change. Raw 19; coupled 19

dashboard_trackers.name: EASTERN DRC
dashboard_trackers.notes: The rolling-day review added no M23 territorial capture, direct Rwanda-DRC clash, mass recruitment order or verified strategic attack beyond the already-scored eastern conflict. Raw 56; coupled 56

dashboard_trackers.name: YEMEN RED SEA
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters verified social video of smoke at the Jazan refinery and reviewed an IIR note saying the 400,000-bpd plant shut after the Houthi attack, with damage to its IGCC complex and tank farm and a tentative 15 August restart; Aramco had not commented. Separately, UKMTO reported an unattributed explosion heard by a tanker in the southern Red Sea with vessel and crew safe, hours after the Houthis claimed missiles forced the Saudi-flagged NCC Ghazal to turn back. These consequences confirm physical infrastructure damage and continued maritime attacks, raising the lane three points while China’s vessel-by-vessel passage channel remains narrow. Raw 95; coupled 95
